text:
priya: noticed p99 on /v2/generate jumped to 2.1s in latency dashboard just now. p50/p95 look normal. dashboard shows sample_count 34 for the window. is this expected?

michael: yep saw that. seems p99 from low-n. histogram shows a couple long tails from a canary route. possible sampling mismatch between source A and B.

ashley: are we mixing sample origins? dashboard rollup merges route-tagged samples but doesn't show per-origin counts by default.

priya: exactly — can we show 'effective_sample_count' and a low-sample flag? p99 should be dimmed if samples<100.

nate: +1. also seen quantile bucketization: our tdigest bucket widths can make p95==p99 when samples small.

michael: proposed API change: /metrics/latency?route=&quantiles=p50,p95,p99 -> include sample_count, origin_breakdown, tdigest_bins . then frontend can compute confidence bands.

ashley: quick PoC: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://int-api.redwood/metrics/latency?route=/v2/generate&quantiles=0.5,0.95,0.99'
response: {"p50":0.12,"p95":0.34,"p99":2.1,"sample_count":34,"origins":{"eu-west":30,"canary":4}}

priya: exact. UI should show a badge 'low sample (34) – p99 unstable' and a tooltip listing origins.

ops-bot: deploy/rollout finished for canary-service v2.1.4 :white_check_mark:

nate: we should also add a rule in rollouts: if canary sample_weight < 1% then suppress p99 alerts for that route.

michael: will add telemetry change + frontend flag. assigning to @ashley for UX mock and @nate to add API fields. timeline?: 1 sprint?

ashley: I'll mock the badge and a collapsed 'show breakdown' panel. will post screenshots in #eng-platform by EOD tomorrow.

nate: I'll add server-side sample_count/origin fields and a boolean 'confidence_low' set when sample_count<100 or tdigest_entropy>threshold.

priya: thanks. also let's add unit test for tdigest behaviour on small n to prevent p99 jumps.

michael: sounds good. if anyone wants to block, ping me. :thumbsup:
